purpose: Verify complete standard success workflow for expense/voucher from creation to recorded completion (one-level approval).
preconditions: Basic User is authenticated and authorized to create expense/voucher requests. Available departmental budget is sufficient for requested amount.
action_or_input:
1. Basic User executes IAA-UC-101 to save request as Draft.
2. Basic User executes IAA-UC-102 to submit request.
3. Finance Staff executes IAA-UC-103 to validate request (passes validation).
4. Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-201 to approve request (no further level required).
5. Finance Staff executes IAA-UC-105 to complete internal processing.
expected_result: Request successfully transitions through states: Not Created -> Draft -> Submitted -> Finance Validated -> Approved -> Recorded. System records complete audit log and timestamp history.

purpose: Verify segregation of duties constraint during expense/voucher standard approval.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Finance Validated state. Approving Authority is identical to the Basic User who created the request.
action_or_input: Creator attempting to act as Approving Authority invokes IAA-UC-201 to approve the request.
expected_result: Approval action by creator is blocked under segregation of duties (IAA-BR-001) and the request is routed to the next eligible configured authority.

purpose: Verify expense/voucher workflow traversal across two sequential configured approval levels to recorded completion.
preconditions: Basic User is authenticated. Multi-level approval routing is configured requiring two distinct approval authorities.
action_or_input:
1. Basic User creates Draft (IAA-UC-101) and submits request (IAA-UC-102).
2. Finance Staff validates request (IAA-UC-103).
3. First Assigned Approving Authority approves with another level required (IAA-UC-201).
4. Next Assigned Approving Authority approves with no further level required (IAA-UC-201).
5. Finance Staff processes and records request (IAA-UC-105).
expected_result: Request successfully transitions: Not Created -> Draft -> Submitted -> Finance Validated -> Approval Pending -> Approved -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify expense/voucher workflow path ending in authority rejection with mandatory remarks.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Finance Validated state.
action_or_input: Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-201 to reject the request, entering mandatory rejection remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions from Finance Validated to Rejected state. Workflow terminates in Rejected state with remarks and authority identity recorded in audit trail.

purpose: Verify expense/voucher Finance clarification query and response cycle followed by successful approval and recording.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Submitted state.
action_or_input:
1. Finance Staff reviews request and raises clarification query (IAA-UC-103).
2. Basic User submits clarification response and supporting documents (IAA-UC-104).
3. Finance Staff re-validates request and confirms validation passes (IAA-UC-103).
4. Assigned Approving Authority approves request (IAA-UC-201).
5. Finance Staff processes and records request (IAA-UC-105).
expected_result: Request successfully transitions: Submitted -> Query Raised -> Query Responded -> Finance Validated -> Approved -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify automatic timeout escalation of overdue expense/voucher approval and subsequent approval by higher authority.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Finance Validated or Approval Pending state. Pending authority approval action duration exceeds configured time limit.
action_or_input: 1. System triggers IAA-UC-203 upon expiration of configured timeout duration.\n2. Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 to approve request (no further level required).\n3. Finance Staff executes IAA-UC-105 to complete internal processing.
expected_result: Request transitions: (Finance Validated or Approval Pending) -> Escalated (via System timeout) -> Approved (via higher authority) -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify rejection of overdue escalated expense/voucher request by higher authority.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Escalated state following System timeout escalation (IAA-UC-203).
action_or_input: Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 providing rejection remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions from Escalated to Rejected state. Rejection remarks, escalation history, and higher authority identity are recorded.

purpose: Verify standard Travel Allowance (TA) processing workflow where claim amount does not require authority approval.
preconditions: Eligible employee is authenticated. TA claim value is below configured high-value threshold.
action_or_input: 1. Basic User (Employee) submits valid TA form with required trip details and documents (IAA-UC-401).\n2. Finance Staff verifies TA form confirming compliance and that high-value approval is not required (IAA-UC-402).\n3. Finance Staff completes internal processing and records the claim (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Verified -> Recorded. Request becomes read-only and recorded.

purpose: Verify high-value TA claim workflow requiring single-level approving authority decision to recorded completion.
preconditions: TA claim amount meets or exceeds configured high-value threshold.
action_or_input:
1. Basic User submits TA form (IAA-UC-401).
2. Finance Staff verifies TA form and determines high-value approval is required (IAA-UC-402).
3. Assigned Approving Authority approves claim with no further level required (IAA-UC-403).
4. Finance Staff processes and records TA claim (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Approval Pending -> Approved -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify segregation of duties enforcement on high-value TA approval when approver is the claimant.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Approval Pending state. Assigned approving authority is identical to claimant.
action_or_input: Claimant acting as approving authority attempts to execute IAA-UC-403 to approve own TA claim.
expected_result: Approval action is blocked under segregation of duties (IAA-BR-001) and claim is routed to next eligible configured authority.

purpose: Verify high-value TA claim traversal across two sequential configured approval levels.
preconditions: High-value TA claim requires multi-level authority approval per configured routing policy.
action_or_input:
1. Basic User submits TA form (IAA-UC-401).
2. Finance Staff verifies TA form requiring approval (IAA-UC-402).
3. First Assigned Approving Authority approves with another level required (IAA-UC-403).
4. Next Assigned Approving Authority approves with no further level required (IAA-UC-403).
5. Finance Staff processes and records TA claim (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Approval Pending -> Approval Pending -> Approved -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify rejection of high-value TA claim by assigned approving authority.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Approval Pending state.
action_or_input: Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-403 to reject claim, providing required remarks.
expected_result: TA claim transitions from Approval Pending to Rejected state. Lifecycle terminates with rejection remarks recorded.

purpose: Verify TA claim clarification query and response cycle during Finance verification.
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted state.
action_or_input:
1. Finance Staff reviews TA claim and raises clarification query (IAA-UC-402).
2. Basic User (Employee) submits clarification response (IAA-UC-104).
3. Finance Staff re-verifies TA form confirming no authority approval is required (IAA-UC-402).
4. Finance Staff processes and records TA claim (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Submitted -> Query Raised -> Query Responded -> Verified -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify manual flagging of material anomaly by Finance/Auditor and direct resolution by designated resolver.
preconditions: Financial record or transaction is under review with No Anomaly state.
action_or_input: 1. Finance Staff or Auditor executes IAA-UC-302 confirming material anomaly.\n2. Designated Anomaly Resolver executes IAA-UC-303 to resolve the anomaly.
expected_result: Anomaly transitions: No Anomaly -> Open -> Resolved. Resolution details, resolver identity, and timestamps are recorded.

purpose: Verify manual anomaly workflow with one escalation traversal before final resolution.
preconditions: Financial record has No Anomaly.
action_or_input: 1. Finance Staff or Auditor flags material anomaly (IAA-UC-302).\n2. Initial Designated Resolver determines escalation is required and executes IAA-UC-303.\n3. Next Designated Resolver reviews escalated anomaly and executes IAA-UC-303 to resolve.
expected_result: Anomaly transitions: No Anomaly -> Open -> Escalated -> Resolved.

purpose: Verify audit observation straight closure path upon satisfactory first response.
preconditions: Auditor is reviewing financial records in No Observation state.
action_or_input: 1. Auditor executes IAA-UC-501 to raise audit observation.\n2. Basic User / Department Representative submits response and evidence (IAA-UC-502).\n3. Auditor verifies response, finds verification satisfactory, and closes observation (IAA-UC-503).
expected_result: Audit observation transitions: No Observation -> Open -> Responded -> Closed.

purpose: Verify audit observation workflow with one unsatisfactory response revision cycle returning to Open before final closure.
preconditions: Auditor is reviewing financial records in No Observation state.
action_or_input:
1. Auditor raises observation (IAA-UC-501).
2. Department Representative submits initial response (IAA-UC-502).
3. Auditor evaluates response as unsatisfactory and returns it (IAA-UC-503).
4. Department Representative submits revised response and evidence (IAA-UC-502).
5. Auditor verifies revised response as satisfactory and closes observation (IAA-UC-503).
expected_result: Audit observation transitions: No Observation -> Open -> Responded -> Open -> Responded -> Closed.

purpose: Verify automatic timeout escalation of overdue high-value TA approval and approval by higher authority.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Approval Pending state. Approving authority action exceeds configured time limit.
action_or_input: 1. System triggers IAA-UC-203 escalating overdue approval.\n2. Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority approves claim with no further approval level required (IAA-UC-202).\n3. Finance Staff processes and records claim (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Approval Pending -> Escalated (via System timeout) -> Approved (via higher authority) -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify rejection of overdue escalated high-value TA claim by higher authority.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Escalated state following System timeout escalation.
action_or_input: Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 with rejection remarks.
expected_result: TA claim transitions from Escalated to Rejected state. Rejection remarks and escalation history are recorded.

purpose: Verify automatic detection and creation of material anomaly by System and direct resolution.
preconditions: System detects a configured material anomaly condition (e.g., budget threshold breach or rule discrepancy). Current anomaly state is No Anomaly.
action_or_input: 1. System triggers IAA-UC-304 upon detecting configured condition to create anomaly.\n2. Designated Anomaly Resolver executes IAA-UC-303 to resolve anomaly.
expected_result: Anomaly transitions: No Anomaly -> Open (via System) -> Resolved (via resolver). System detection details and resolver action are logged.

purpose: Verify automatic anomaly creation followed by one escalation traversal to higher resolver before resolution.
preconditions: System detects configured material anomaly condition in No Anomaly state.
action_or_input: 1. System triggers IAA-UC-304 creating Open anomaly.\n2. Initial Designated Resolver determines further escalation is required (IAA-UC-303).\n3. Next Designated Resolver executes IAA-UC-303 to resolve anomaly.
expected_result: Anomaly transitions: No Anomaly -> Open (via System) -> Escalated -> Resolved.

purpose: Verify full composite Expense/Voucher lifecycle exercising Draft creation, submission, clarification loop, validation, and multi-level approval to Recorded completion.
preconditions: Basic User is authorized. Multi-level approval is configured. Request requires clarification during Finance review.
action_or_input:
1. Basic User saves Draft (IAA-UC-101).
2. Basic User submits request (IAA-UC-102).
3. Finance Staff raises clarification query (IAA-UC-103).
4. Basic User responds to query (IAA-UC-104).
5. Finance Staff validates request (IAA-UC-103).
6. Approving Authority approves requiring another level (IAA-UC-201).
7. Next Approving Authority grants final approval (IAA-UC-201).
8. Finance Staff completes internal processing and records request (IAA-UC-105).
expected_result: Request progresses through composite path: Not Created -> Draft -> Submitted -> Query Raised -> Query Responded -> Finance Validated -> Approval Pending -> Approved -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify composite Expense/Voucher lifecycle path ending in rejection by assigned approving authority.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is submitted and validated by Finance (Finance Validated or Approval Pending state).
action_or_input: Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-201 to reject request with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions from (Finance Validated or Approval Pending) to Rejected state. Workflow terminates.

purpose: Verify composite Expense/Voucher lifecycle escalation path via System timeout and approval by higher authority.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Finance Validated or Approval Pending state. Pending authority approval action duration exceeds configured time limit.
action_or_input: 1. System executes IAA-UC-203 upon timeout trigger.\n2. Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 approving the request.\n3. Finance Staff executes IAA-UC-105 recording the request.
expected_result: Request transitions: (Finance Validated or Approval Pending) -> Escalated -> Approved (or Approval Pending if further level required) -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify composite Expense/Voucher lifecycle escalation path via System timeout and rejection by higher authority.
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is in Escalated state following timeout escalation.
action_or_input: Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 to reject request with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions from Escalated to Rejected state. Workflow terminates with rejection logged.

purpose: Verify composite TA lifecycle path for standard TA with Finance clarification traversal to Recorded completion.
preconditions: Eligible employee submits TA claim not requiring authority approval.
action_or_input:
1. Basic User submits TA form (IAA-UC-401).
2. Finance Staff requests clarification (IAA-UC-402).
3. Basic User responds to clarification (IAA-UC-104).
4. Finance Staff verifies TA form (IAA-UC-402, no authority approval required).
5. Finance Staff records TA request (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Query Raised -> Query Responded -> Verified -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify composite TA lifecycle path with direct Finance rejection on policy verification failure.
preconditions: TA claim is submitted or query responded.
action_or_input: Finance Staff executes IAA-UC-402 verifying claim against policy and identifies non-compliant policy violation.
expected_result: TA claim transitions from (Submitted or Query Responded) directly to Rejected state (IAA-BR-201). Claim is closed.

purpose: Verify composite TA lifecycle high-value path with multi-level authority approval to Recorded completion.
preconditions: High-value TA claim verified by Finance requiring authority approval across multiple configured levels.
action_or_input:
1. Finance Staff verifies TA form requiring authority approval (IAA-UC-402).
2. Assigned Approving Authority approves claim with further level required (IAA-UC-403).
3. Next Assigned Approving Authority grants final approval (IAA-UC-403).
4. Finance Staff records approved TA request (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: (Submitted or Query Responded) -> Approval Pending -> Approval Pending -> Approved -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify composite TA lifecycle path where approving authority rejects high-value TA claim.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Approval Pending state.
action_or_input: Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-403 to reject claim with remarks.
expected_result: TA claim transitions from Approval Pending to Rejected state.

purpose: Verify composite TA lifecycle path with System timeout escalation and higher authority approval.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Approval Pending state. Authority action exceeds configured timeout.
action_or_input: 1. System executes IAA-UC-203 escalating overdue approval.\n2. Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 approving claim.\n3. Finance Staff records approved request (IAA-UC-404).
expected_result: TA claim transitions: Approval Pending -> Escalated -> Approved (or Approval Pending if another level required) -> Recorded.

purpose: Verify composite TA lifecycle path with System timeout escalation and higher authority rejection.
preconditions: High-value TA claim is in Escalated state following System timeout.
action_or_input: Next/Higher Assigned Approving Authority executes IAA-UC-202 to reject claim with remarks.
expected_result: TA claim transitions from Escalated to Rejected state.

purpose: Verify composite Anomaly lifecycle from manual flagging through resolution or escalation.
preconditions: Financial record has No Anomaly. Finance Staff or Auditor detects material anomaly.
action_or_input: 1. Finance Staff or Auditor executes IAA-UC-302 to flag anomaly.\n2. Designated Anomaly Resolver executes IAA-UC-303 to resolve anomaly directly.
expected_result: Anomaly transitions: No Anomaly -> Open -> Resolved.

purpose: Verify composite Anomaly lifecycle from automatic system detection through escalation and resolution.
preconditions: System detects configured material anomaly condition (IAA-BR-102, IAA-BR-103) in No Anomaly state.
action_or_input: 1. System executes IAA-UC-304 creating Open anomaly.\n2. Initial Designated Anomaly Resolver executes IAA-UC-303 escalating anomaly.\n3. Next Designated Anomaly Resolver executes IAA-UC-303 resolving anomaly.
expected_result: Anomaly transitions: No Anomaly -> Open (via System) -> Escalated -> Resolved.

purpose: Verify composite Audit Observation lifecycle integrating response submission and straight closure.
preconditions: Auditor reviews record in No Observation state.
action_or_input: 1. Auditor executes IAA-UC-501 to raise observation.\n2. Department Representative executes IAA-UC-502 submitting response and evidence.\n3. Auditor executes IAA-UC-503 verifying response as satisfactory and closing observation.
expected_result: Audit observation transitions: No Observation -> Open -> Responded -> Closed.

purpose: Verify composite Audit Observation lifecycle with unsatisfactory response returning to Open before satisfactory closure.
preconditions: Audit observation is in Responded state with initial response submitted.
action_or_input: 1. Auditor executes IAA-UC-503 finding verification unsatisfactory.\n2. Department Representative executes IAA-UC-502 submitting revised response and evidence.\n3. Auditor executes IAA-UC-503 finding verification satisfactory and closing observation.
expected_result: Audit observation transitions: Responded -> Open (verification unsatisfactory) -> Responded (revised response) -> Closed (verification satisfactory).
